Package org.apache.hadoop.hbase.filter

Class TestFilterListHintDelegation

java.lang.Object
org.apache.hadoop.hbase.filter.TestFilterListHintDelegation
@Tag("org.apache.hadoop.hbase.testclassification.FilterTests") @Tag("org.apache.hadoop.hbase.testclassification.SmallTests") public class TestFilterListHintDelegation extends Object
Unit tests for getHintForRejectedRow and getSkipHint delegation in composite filters (FilterList, SkipFilter, WhileMatchFilter).

    • fixedRejectedRowHintFilter

      private static org.apache.hadoop.hbase.filter.FilterBase fixedRejectedRowHintFilter(org.apache.hadoop.hbase.Cell hint)
      Filter that returns a fixed hint from getHintForRejectedRow without overriding filterRowKey. Used in OR / SkipFilter / WhileMatchFilter tests where the AND per-sub-filter rejection tracking does not apply.

    • rejectingRowHintFilter

      private static org.apache.hadoop.hbase.filter.FilterBase rejectingRowHintFilter(org.apache.hadoop.hbase.Cell hint)
      Filter that rejects every row via filterRowKey and returns a fixed hint. Used in AND tests where FilterListWithAND.getHintForRejectedRow requires sub-filters to have individually rejected via filterRowKey before being consulted.
